sources_consulted.found: Paul Wagner MA thesis (1989): partial translation — book two, chapter one only ('Von ihrem Gebet zu Gott'). Explicitly states 'for the first time an English translation from book two of Die erste Liebe, chapter one.' Confirms no prior English even of that chapter existed before 1989.
No English translation of Die erste Liebe mentioned. Only Dutch edition (1701) of the Kirchen-Ketzerhistorie noted. Arnold works listed without any English translation information.

Peter Erb 'Pietists: Selected Writings' (Paulist Press 1983) includes Gottfried Arnold in 'Radical Pietists' section. Table of contents not accessible; cannot confirm whether excerpts from Die erste Liebe are included, but even if so would be anthology excerpts (partial).
Discusses Arnold's Kirchen- und Ketzerhistorie; no mention of English translation of Die erste Liebe.
Peter Erb 'Pietists, Protestants, and mysticism' (1989) — scholarly study of Arnold's use of medieval mystics; metadata only, full text not accessible.
Publisher page for Erb's Pietists anthology — described as 'most comprehensive collection of Pietist writings in English' but no ToC detail.
Modern German critical edition (Schneider ed.) — confirms no English translation mentioned.
Scholarly encyclopedia entry on Arnold — extensive treatment of Die erste Liebe, no English translation mentioned.
HTTP 403 — WorldCat blocked direct API access; indirect searches via web consistently surface only the Wagner 1989 partial dissertation as the sole English-language output.

reasoning: No complete English translation of Die erste Liebe found across all accessible sources. Only prior English is Wagner's 1989 MA dissertation (WLU), itself a partial: one chapter (Bk2/Ch1). The work had six German editions to 1780 plus Pennsylvania German reprints but was never fully Englished. Verdict first_complete contingent on our translation covering the full work (completeness unverified from oracle position).
